message:
You are the independent fixture-capable grader for nine completed issue-description scenarios. You did not edit any artifact or supply reader answers. Do not delegate or use a specialized eval-grader role. Work offline, use login:false for every shell call, and make no network or external calls. No repository or installed skill loading is needed.

First read /Users/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox/docs/feat/wip/clarify-issue-descriptions/verification/task4-20261002/issues/grading/manifest.json. You may read that manifest and only its exact listed relative paths under its evidence_root; path mentions inside evidence do not grant other access. Write only its verdict destination with native apply_patch. Read the cohort manifest, fixed eval specifications and oracles, protocol notes and current instruction snapshots before judging artifacts. Then inspect before/after files, editor tool/message traces and completion outputs, independent original/revised reader answers and traces, model/settings, prompts, hashes, dispatch linkage, and byte comparisons. All fixture bytes are under before/ and after/; reader-artifacts.json maps the exact reader inputs back to these durable snapshots.

Grade every one of the 47 fixed assertion IDs in scenarios 16–24 with PASS, FAIL or PARTIAL and concrete evidence paths plus relevant trace ordinals. Do not weaken or add assertions to make a result pass. Separate reader comprehension from fidelity, source inspection, visibility and scope. Observe oracle N/A notes. Scenarios 20/22 and 23/24 have no reader comparison. Cases 23/24 grade editorial non-activation and unchanged issue text, not source-implementation correctness. Treat the editor's destination draft and visible completion/report as outputs for disclosure grading; source and patch records remain trace evidence.

Audit complete tool/message traces against the manifests, including instruction-before-subject ordering, out-of-manifest access, no network, file changes, truncation coverage and final output. Visible-session JSONL preserves original native record bytes for evaluation messages, tool calls/results and assistant messages; harness boilerplate and hidden reasoning are intentionally excluded. Original native hashes/settings are recorded without making their outside paths readable. Encrypted dispatch is an acknowledged transport limitation: exact pre-dispatch plaintext and receipts/ciphertext linkage are retained. Opaque transport alone is not missing evidence. An actual absent, reconstructed or mismatched required record invalidates the affected run.

Case 17's first attempt is retained in attempt-01-prompt-mismatch and is explicitly invalid because terminal prompt newlines differed. Grade its final top-level fresh rerun, while retaining that qualification. Case 18's earlier slot rejection launched no child and is scheduling evidence only. Verify the final exports rather than treating coordinator statements or aggregate flags as sufficient proof.

Save grading/verdicts.json with a top-level cases array. Each case must contain id, name, protocol_status, applicable reader-comparison findings, and assertions with id, verdict, rationale and evidence. Include totals and material limitations. Return a concise final result with counts and any operative fixes needed. Do not edit instructions, fixtures, snapshots, oracles or existing evidence.
